tagline: The 'Gateway to South India' offers Marina Beach, colourful Dravidian temples, Carnatic music and classic South Indian food on the Bay of Bengal.
overview: Chennai, formerly Madras, is the capital of Tamil Nadu on the Bay of Bengal. It grew around Fort St George, which the British East India Company founded in 1644, and it is now a major centre for car manufacturing, IT and healthcare.

Marina Beach, a long urban beach, is where locals gather at sunset. In Mylapore, the Kapaleeshwarar Temple has a towering, sculpted gopuram, while San Thome Basilica is built over the tomb attributed to St Thomas the Apostle.

Chennai is a centre of Carnatic music and Bharatanatyam dance, celebrated each December and January during the Madras Music Season. Filter coffee, dosas and banana-leaf meals are local staples, and the UNESCO-listed shore temples of Mahabalipuram are a short drive south.
